claim_surface: Discovery data. No superiority, generality, published-comparison or Stage-3 claim, and no paper-facing effectiveness claim at all. No knob tuned on the evaluation ten: the plan's rules were fixed model-free before any score existed. No Earnings-22 contact, no fstalign install, no diarizer re-run, no speaker naming, no OBS-E1b contact-matched control.

contacts_and_audio.equal_contact_statement: A contact-matched control is IMPOSSIBLE BY CONSTRUCTION and was declared so before the flight (section 5): a call cut at its speaker turns yields 5,122 pieces and there is no way to cut it into speaker-turn units AND into 1,593 of them. The contrast is the TRANSPORT UNIT AS A WHOLE and it confounds boundary placement (11.0 % of unit cuts land mid-speech against 65.5 % of window cuts), speaker purity (76.1 % single-speaker units against 40.5 %) and contact count/length (5,122 x 27.60 s against 1,593 x 88.73 s). The control that WOULD separate contact count -- a fixed-window arm at obs_buffer_seconds 27.60, OBS-E1b -- is named as the follow-up and is deliberately not registered.

no_pause_call.why_apart: zero detected pauses of 300 ms or more over 1,817.7 s; every one of its units ends on an active frame, so it is the one call where the transport unit cannot buy a silent boundary

own_null_margins.note: the per-metric Earnings-21 non-inferiority margin is the half-width of that cell's own call-clustered CI90; the semantic one is ADVISORY because that null's interval excludes zero

pairing.power_limitation: n = 44 clusters is BELOW the program's n >= 400 rule for a paired effectiveness claim. This cell reports an interval and a direction and makes NO paper-facing effectiveness claim.
